decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. DWL 01fDWL 02 - site location planPLANNING STATEMENTReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external materials used in the construction of the additional storey shall be of a similar appearance to those used in the existing dwellinghouse.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development in accordance with Class AA of Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

The development shall not commence until a Construction Management Plan is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall be written in accordance with London Best Practice Guidance and contain the following: a)	A photographic condition survey of the footways in front of the site. b)	Arrangements for the loading, unloading, and turning of delivery, construction, and service vehicles. c)	Arrangements for the parking of contractors' vehicles. d)	Arrangements for the storage of materials. e)	Hours of work. f)	Arrangements for deliveries. g)	The storage and removal of material. h)	Measures to reduce danger to pedestrians and cyclists. i)	Measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during the demolition and construction in accordance with the Mayor of London's supplementary planning guidance 'The Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved construction management plan. Reason: To ensure construction does not lead to damage of the nearby public road network and to minimise disruption to the neighbouring properties.
